lines.text: This tiny animal survived the vacuum of space.
No spacesuit. And wait for what happened next.
Meet the tardigrade, or water bear. Most are a millimeter long, or less.
lines.caption: Meet the tardigrade, or water bear. Most are 1 mm long, or less.

lines.text: To survive, it dries out into a lifeless-looking ball called a tun.
In two thousand seven, thousands of dried ones rode a capsule into orbit.
lines.caption: In 2007, thousands of dried ones rode a capsule into orbit.

lines.text: Exposed to open space for over a week, most survived the vacuum. A few even survived raw sunlight.
Back on Earth, add water: they woke up, and laid eggs that hatched!
Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
